base_image_note: cuda12.6.0 has a directory in the repo but is not published on DockerHub; 12.2.0 is published, matches the host driver's CUDA version, and is the tag Boltz/2.2.0 and ESM3/3.2.0 both use. The pip torch wheels carry their own CUDA 12.6 runtime, so the base tag does not set the compute stack.

docker_reclaimable_gb.note: not pruned - left for the owner to decide

weights.note: All three repos are published with fp32 tensors and all three are cast to bf16 here. load_esmc() defaults to precision='bf16' and the trunks are loaded with torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, so the baked bf16 copies are bit-identical at inference.

build_gotchas: esm declares transformers as a direct URL on @main, so pip raises ResolutionImpossible against a commit pin. Install esm first (it resolves its own tree), then pip install --no-deps --force-reinstall pinned transformers. main has already moved past 3a8956fb, so the pin is load-bearing for reproducing the Round 4 runs.

import esm initialises Triton's driver ('0 active drivers' with no GPU), and docker build has no GPU. The build gate therefore verifies torch's version string, both commit SHAs from direct_url.json, and module paths on disk; imports and a real fold are verified in the GPU validation run.

apptainer build's mksquashfs defaults to 25% of physical RAM (~15 GB of the box's 62 GB), but jobs submitted without an explicit #SBATCH --mem get DefMemPerCPU=2000 MB and are OOM-killed at SIF creation. Build with --mksquashfs-args '-mem 512M -processors 2', or request memory explicitly.

ESMFold2InputBuilder() calls load_ccd(), which ignores ESMFOLD2_MODELS and hf_hub_downloads biohub/ESMFold2 ccd.pkl into the HF cache. Baking ccd.pkl into /app/models/ESMFold2 is not enough: set ESMCFOLD_CCD_PATH (note the spelling, ESMCFOLD not ESMFOLD2; read at import time in esm/models/esmfold2/conformers.py) to the file. Caught only by folding under --containall --net --network=none; with a host HF cache mounted the container appears stand-alone but is not. definition.def's %test now asserts the var resolves.

validation.note: no host $HOME, no host /tmp, no route to the Hub, so a fold can only use baked weights
